principle: Fiscal-year code set editions are never silently mixed. Every coding record carries the encounter date and the edition in force on that date, and QA rejects a record whose encounter date falls outside its declared edition window.
verificationCaveat: The window boundaries below are transcribed from the owner-supplied charter, not retrieved from CDC/NCHS or CMS in this session.
